learning: Controller tuned to new geometry: base_speed reduced slightly to 0.1 for stability with narrower wheel_track; kp increased to 1.15 to improve steering responsiveness with smaller sensors; kd increased to 0.015 to damp oscillations; ki kept moderate at 0.05 to correct steady-state errors. Sensor weights kept symmetric and balanced for 7 sensors. Line loss strategy remains search_left for consistent recovery.
notes: Adjusted controller gains to balance increased agility from narrower wheel_track and sharper sensor resolution from smaller sensor_size. Expect improved steering precision and fewer off-track events. Observation request matches upstream to monitor key performance metrics.
rationale: The narrower wheel_track of 0.13 should improve turning agility but risks instability; reducing base_speed slightly to 0.1 helps maintain control. Smaller sensor_size 0.008 sharpens line edge detection but reduces sensor signal strength, so increasing kp to 1.15 improves steering responsiveness to clearer signals. Increasing kd to 0.015 helps damp steering oscillations observed previously. Ki remains at 0.05 to correct steady-state errors without causing overshoot. Sensor positions adjusted by ±0.005 optimize coverage and reduce overlap, supporting better line detection. This controller tuning aims to leverage the geometry changes to reduce off-track events and steering oscillations, improving overall progress and completion likelihood.
